_comment: The getting-started chain for each player's first days (PLAN.md M4 step 6, M5 step 23). Each step is done by doing it once, in any order; its reward then waits to be claimed from the quest card and goes to the player's first village. `how` says what to tap, step by step; `show` is what the quest card's Show me points at. The `story` is the elder's reason for asking. `finale` is the reward for claiming every step. A step's `solo` replaces its words in a solo world, where there are no teammates.

steps.title: Raise a building
steps.hint: Open your village and queue any building or field upgrade.
steps.story: The elder looks at the thin palisade and the half-empty fields. "Walls and bread first, child. Everything else grows from them."
how: Tap Village in the top bar.
Tap an empty plot or a building in the village.
Tap Build or Upgrade in the sheet.

steps.title: Train defenders
steps.hint: Build a Barracks and train any unit there.
steps.story: "The hordes do not wait for the harvest. Put spears in the hands of those who can hold them."
how: Build a Barracks on a free plot in the village (no free plot? Upgrade the Elder's Hall: each level opens one).
When it stands, open the Troops tab.
Pick a unit and a number, then tap Train.

steps.title: Claim an outpost
steps.hint: Tap a forest, hill, field or mine hex near your village and claim it.
steps.story: "The land around us is rich, and nobody tends it. Set a camp there before the beasts do."
how: Go back to the map.
Tap a forest, hills, plains, mountain or lake hex next to your village.
In the sheet, tap Claim beside Build an outpost.

steps.title: Send scouts
steps.hint: Build a Scout Lodge and send scouts at a horde, a camp or an ancient site.
steps.story: "Fear is what you feel about a thing you have not seen. Go and see it."
how: Build a Scout Lodge on a free plot in the village (no free plot? Upgrade the Elder's Hall).
Tap the threat line in the top bar.
Pick a horde and tap Send scouts.

steps.title: Clear your first camp
steps.hint: Send an army to storm a bandit camp or a lair (order: storm it).
steps.story: "A camp of beasts in the woods is a wave that has not yet happened. Burn it out."
how: Find a camp on the map: there is one near your village (the tents).
Tap it, choose your troops in the sheet and order them to storm it.

steps.title: Gift a teammate
steps.hint: Send a caravan to a teammate's village or to the Holy City vault.
steps.story: "No village stands alone. What you share now comes back to you on the night the walls shake."
how: Build a Caravan Yard on a free plot in the village (no free plot? Upgrade the Elder's Hall: each level opens one).
Open the Caravans tab.
Load resources and send them to a teammate or to the Holy City vault.

solo.title: Fill the Holy City's vault
solo.hint: Send a caravan of resources to the Holy City vault.
solo.story: "The Holy City feeds the bridge and the guard on its walls. What you send now comes back to you on the night the walls shake."
how: Build a Caravan Yard on a free plot in the village (no free plot? Upgrade the Elder's Hall: each level opens one).
Open the Caravans tab.
Load resources and send them to the Holy City vault.

finale.title: Ready for the hordes
finale.story: The elder nods at last. "Now you know the ways of the steppe and the forest. The rest you will learn from the hordes themselves."
